description: This file defines the CreditReportData class, a serializable data transfer object (DTO) used within the credit bureau infrastructure of the Apache Fineract project. It contains fields for id, creditBureauId, and nationalId, and includes methods for object creation and chainable setters.
external_methods: Serializable (interface method: none, used for serialization)
lombok.Data (annotation processing for methods like getters, setters, toString)
